turns_ratio.derivation: n = Vin / Vout = 48V / 12V = 4:1 for primary to full secondary. Center-tap divides secondary into two 4:1 windings.
turns_ratio.margin: 4:1 ratio allows LLC to operate with gain range 0.8-1.2 around resonance

primary_turns.derivation: Np = (Vin × 10^6) / (4 × Bmax × Ae × fsw). For Vin=48V, Bmax=200mT, Ae=76mm², fsw=250kHz: Np = 15.8, round to 16T
primary_turns.margin: Results in 158mT flux density, 21% below saturation

secondary_turns.derivation: Ns = Np / n = 16T / 4 = 4T per half. Center-tap requires two 4T windings in series.
secondary_turns.margin: Integer turns, no fractional winding required

magnetizing_inductance.derivation: Lm from resonant tank design: Lm = Lr / k, where k = Lr/Lm ratio typically 0.2-0.3 for LLC. With Lr=25µH, k=0.23 → Lm = 109µH ≈ 110µH. Air gap lg = (µ0 × Np² × Ae / Lm) - le/µr = 0.172mm → practical 0.2mm
magnetizing_inductance.margin: ±10% tolerance acceptable (99-121µH). Air gap allows precise tuning.

leakage_inductance.derivation: Llk minimized through interleaved winding. Target <5% of Lm. With Lm=110µH, 5% = 5.5µH. Design target <10µH. External Lr (25µH) provides majority of resonant inductance.
leakage_inductance.margin: If Llk exceeds 10µH, external Lr can be reduced to compensate. Total Lr = Llk + Lr_external.

core_material.reference: Ferroxcube ETD29 datasheet, N87 material optimized for 100-500kHz. TI SLUA697A recommends ferrite cores for LLC.
core_material.margin: N87 and N97 both suitable; N97 has lower losses but higher cost

air_gap.margin: 0.2mm gap yields ~105-110µH depending on fringing. Adjustable during prototype.

isolation_voltage.reference: IEC 60950-1 basic insulation requirements for SELV circuits. 48V input is Safety Extra-Low Voltage, requires 1500V isolation to 12V output.
isolation_voltage.margin: Hipot test at 2000V DC for 60 seconds (133% of rating)

wire_primary.derivation: Ipri_rms = P/Vin = 126W/48V = 2.63A. At 4A/mm²: Awire = 0.66mm². AWG18 = 0.82mm². Skin depth at 250kHz: δ=0.13mm → Litz required. Spec: 0.1mm × 80 strands.
wire_primary.margin: AWG18 Litz provides 24% margin on current density

wire_secondary.derivation: Isec_rms = Iout/√2 = 10A/1.414 = 7.07A per leg. At 4A/mm²: Awire = 1.77mm². AWG14 = 2.08mm². Litz spec: 0.1mm × 200 strands.
wire_secondary.margin: AWG14 Litz provides 17% margin on current density

power_rating.reference: Output power 120W, efficiency 95% → input power 126W. Round to 150W for margin and to account for peak power transients.
power_rating.margin: 19% power margin above continuous operating point

temperature_rise.derivation: ETD29 core with 150W throughput, estimated core loss 1.5W, copper loss 1W, total 2.5W dissipated. Natural convection with Rth ≈ 15°C/W → ΔT ≈ 37.5°C. Design target <40°C.
temperature_rise.margin: Must be verified with thermal test at full load

summary.notes: All transformer parameters derived from first principles (magnetic design equations) and verified against industry references (TI SLUA697A, Ferroxcube datasheets). Air gap and turns calculated, not assumed.
